pinyin: dé bù gū, bì yǒu lín
literal: virtue · not · alone, surely · have · neighbours
natural: The virtuous are never alone; they will have neighbours

meaning.en: A person of good character will never be isolated; like-minded people will gather around.
meaning.zh: 有德行的人不会孤立，必定有志同道合的人亲近他。

examples.zh: “德不孤，必有邻”，正直的人总会有朋友。
examples.en: “The virtuous are never alone”; upright people always find friends.

examples.zh: 他坚持做好事，渐渐有了一群志同道合的伙伴，真是德不孤，必有邻。
examples.en: He kept doing good, and gradually gathered like-minded companions.

examples.zh: 演讲结尾，她引用“德不孤，必有邻”鼓励大家。
examples.en: She ended the speech with this line to encourage everyone.

story.en: Confucius said: 'Virtue is never alone; it is sure to have neighbours.'

usage.en: Encouragement to people who feel lonely for holding to principle. Formal or literary.
usage.zh: 常用于鼓励坚持原则而感孤独的人。书面或正式语体。

text: 独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻
pinyin: dú xué ér wú yǒu, zé gū lòu ér guǎ wén
literal: alone · study · and · no · friend, then · isolated · narrow · and · few · hear
natural: Study alone without friends and you grow narrow and ill-informed

meaning.en: Without companions to learn with, one's knowledge stays narrow.
meaning.zh: 一个人独自学习而没有朋友切磋，见识就会浅陋狭隘。

equivalents: learning without friends leaves one narrow-minded
no man is an island in learning

examples.zh: 老师引用“独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻”，鼓励大家组成学习小组。
examples.en: The teacher quoted this line to encourage study groups.

examples.zh: 独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻，多交流才能进步。
examples.en: Without friends to study with, one grows narrow; talk with others to improve.

examples.zh: 读书会让我体会到独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻的道理。
examples.en: The reading club taught me the truth of this saying.

story.en: The Record of Learning lists study methods: 'Learning alone without friends leaves one narrow and ill-informed.'
story.zh: 《学记》：“独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻。”

usage.en: The source of the idiom 孤陋寡闻. Used to promote collaboration in study.
usage.zh: 成语“孤陋寡闻”即出于此。常用来提倡互相切磋学习。

meaning.en: To understand and value one another deeply.

examples.zh: 几十年来，他们相知相惜。
examples.en: For decades they have understood and cherished each other.

examples.zh: 相知相惜的朋友，一生难求。
examples.en: Friends who truly know and value each other are hard to find.

examples.zh: 这对老夫妻相知相惜，携手走过五十年。
examples.en: The old couple understood and cherished each other through fifty years.

usage.en: Used for friends or couples. A fixed four-character phrase rather than a classical idiom.
usage.zh: 可用于朋友或夫妻。属常用四字短语，非古典成语。

meaning.en: A friendship so close that formalities and differences in rank are forgotten.
meaning.zh: 彼此不拘形迹、不计身份的至交。

equivalents: friends who stand on no ceremony

examples.zh: 两人是忘形之交，见面从不客套。
examples.en: The two are friends who stand on no ceremony and never exchange pleasantries.

examples.zh: 老教授与青年学者结为忘形之交。
examples.en: The old professor and the young scholar became easy and equal friends.

examples.zh: 忘形之交，往往不拘小节。
examples.en: Friends of this kind rarely worry about small formalities.

usage.en: Literary. 忘形 here means ignoring status and manners, not forgetting oneself.
usage.zh: 书面语。“忘形”指不拘身份礼节。

meaning.en: People with the same views or interests respond to one another and come together.
meaning.zh: 志趣相同的人互相呼应、彼此感应。

equivalents: birds of a feather answer each other

examples.zh: 几位同行同声相应，很快就达成了共识。
examples.en: The colleagues responded to one another and quickly agreed.

examples.zh: 志同道合者同声相应，社团越办越大。
examples.en: Like-minded people answer one another and the club grew.

examples.zh: 他的号召得到各地读者的同声相应。
examples.en: His call was echoed by readers everywhere.

story.en: From the commentary on the Qian hexagram: 'Those of the same sound answer each other; those of the same qi seek each other.'

date.zh: 西周至战国 · 前9—前3世纪
date.en: Western Zhou to Warring States, 9th–3rd c. BC

usage.en: Usually paired with 同气相求 ('like minds seek each other'). Literary; positive.
usage.zh: 常与“同气相求”连用。书面语，褒义。

meaning.en: To hold a wine cup and talk cheerfully with friends.

equivalents: raise a glass and chat merrily

examples.zh: 老友重逢，把酒言欢到深夜。
examples.en: The old friends reunited and chatted merrily over wine until late.

examples.zh: 春节里，亲友们把酒言欢。
examples.en: At Spring Festival, relatives and friends talked cheerfully over drinks.

examples.zh: 他向往与知己把酒言欢的日子。
examples.en: He longed for days of drinking and chatting with close friends.

usage.en: Literary; warm. Often seen in invitations and greetings. Compare 握手言欢 (making up after a quarrel).
usage.zh: 书面语，温馨。常见于邀约、问候。注意与“握手言欢”（和好）区别。

meaning.en: To get together and make friends through drinking.
meaning.zh: 通过饮酒聚会来结交朋友。

examples.zh: 爱喝酒的人以酒会友，很快成了朋友。
examples.en: Those who like drinking made friends over wine.

examples.zh: 他们办了个品酒会，以酒会友。
examples.en: They held a wine tasting to meet friends over drinks.

examples.zh: 以酒会友是中国的一种交际传统。
examples.en: Making friends over wine is a Chinese social tradition.

usage.en: Neutral to slightly literary. Often a banner slogan for tasting events; do not overuse in contexts discouraging alcohol.
usage.zh: 中性偏书面，常用作品酒活动的口号。

pinyin: yǒu yì dì jiǔ tiān cháng
natural: may friendship last as long as heaven and earth

meaning.en: A wish that friendship will endure for ever.
meaning.zh: 祝愿友谊长存、永不改变。

equivalents: may our friendship last for ever

examples.zh: 在联欢会上，大家共同祝愿：友谊地久天长！
examples.en: At the party, everyone toasted: may our friendship last for ever!

examples.zh: 毕业纪念册上写着“友谊地久天长”。
examples.en: The graduation album was inscribed “friendship forever”.

examples.zh: 两国人民友谊地久天长。
examples.en: May the friendship between our peoples last for ever.

usage.en: A wish or slogan; the Chinese title of the song 'Auld Lang Syne' (《友谊地久天长》). Built on 天长地久.
usage.zh: 祝愿语、口号；同时是歌曲《友谊地久天长》（Auld Lang Syne）的中文名。由“天长地久”化出。

natural: break a willow twig to say farewell

meaning.en: To offer a willow twig to a departing friend, an old custom of farewell.
meaning.zh: 送别时折下柳枝赠给远行的人，表示依依不舍。

equivalents: give a willow twig at parting

examples.zh: 古人折柳送别，因为“柳”与“留”谐音。
examples.en: The ancients broke willow twigs at parting because 柳 sounds like 留 'stay'.

examples.zh: 诗里常见折柳送别的场景。
examples.en: Poems often depict the scene of breaking willow to say goodbye.

examples.zh: 车站里没有了折柳送别，只剩下手机里的挥手。
examples.en: No more willow twigs at the station, only waves on phone screens.

usage.en: A custom, not strictly a fixed idiom; literary. See also 灞桥折柳. Pun: 柳 liǔ ~ 留 liú 'stay'.
usage.zh: 属风俗典故，书面语，参见“灞桥折柳”。谐音：柳～留。

synonyms: 挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣

meaning.en: The classic image of parting: at Ba Bridge outside Chang'an, friends broke willow twigs for departing travellers.
meaning.zh: 唐代长安人在灞桥边折柳送别，成为送别的典型意象。

examples.zh: 灞桥折柳，是唐诗里常见的意象。
examples.en: Breaking willow at Ba Bridge is a common image in Tang poetry.

examples.zh: 他在诗里用灞桥折柳写别情。
examples.en: In his poem he used the willow of Ba Bridge to express parting.

examples.zh: 西安灞桥公园每年举办灞桥折柳文化节。
examples.en: Xi'an's Ba Bridge park holds a willow-breaking culture festival every year.

usage.en: Allusion to the Tang custom: the Ba River bridge east of Chang'an was where people saw off travellers. Literary.
usage.zh: 典出唐代：长安城东灞桥是送别之地，人们折柳相赠。书面语。

natural: say farewell at the roadside pavilion

meaning.en: To see a traveller off at the pavilion on the road, a classic scene of parting.
meaning.zh: 在路边长亭为远行者饯别。

equivalents: see someone off at the pavilion

examples.zh: 古人常在长亭送别，折柳赠友。
examples.en: The ancients often said farewell at the roadside pavilion and gave willow to friends.

examples.zh: 《西厢记》“长亭送别”一折极为动人。
examples.en: The “Farewell at the Pavilion” scene of the Western Chamber is very moving.

examples.zh: 长亭送别，满眼是离愁。
examples.en: Parting at the pavilion, eyes full of sorrow.

usage.en: Pavilions were built every ten or five li along roads as rest and parting spots. Also the title of a famous scene in the 《西厢记》.
usage.zh: 古代道旁每隔十里或五里设亭供休息、饯别。也是《西厢记》中一出名场景。

meaning.en: Roadside rest pavilions; image of a place of farewell.
meaning.zh: 古时道旁供行人休息、送别的亭子，代指送别之地。

equivalents: the farewell pavilion on the road

examples.zh: 十里长亭，古人在此依依惜别。
examples.en: At the ten-li pavilion the ancients bade tearful farewells.

examples.zh: 歌词里“十里长亭”勾起人对离别的想象。
examples.en: The lyrics' “ten-li pavilion” evokes the imagery of parting.

examples.zh: 十里长亭送君去，一步一回头。
examples.en: Seeing you off beyond the ten-li pavilion, I glance back at every step.

usage.en: By the old system there was a 短亭 every five li and a 长亭 every ten. Literary image of farewell.
usage.zh: 古制十里一长亭、五里一短亭。书面意象，代指送别。

text: 挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣
pinyin: huī shǒu zì zī qù, xiāo xiāo bān mǎ míng
literal: wave · hand · from · here · go, whinny · whinny · parting · horse · neigh
natural: Waving, we part here; the horses whinny as they separate

meaning.en: A wave of the hand as friends part; even the horses seem to neigh in sorrow.
meaning.zh: 挥手告别，从这里分手；离群的马也萧萧悲鸣，寄托惜别之情。

equivalents: a wave and we part, even the horses cry

examples.zh: 站台上，他挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣，心里满是不舍。
examples.en: On the platform he waved goodbye, heart heavy with reluctance.

examples.zh: 毕业赠言里，她抄下“挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣”。
examples.en: In the graduation message she copied out this line.

examples.zh: 挥手自兹去，从此各奔前程。
examples.en: With a wave we parted, each going our own way.

story.en: Li Bai sends a friend off outside the city, ending with the image of the friend's horse neighing as they part.
story.zh: 李白送友人至城外，以马的鸣叫写离别的悲凉。

usage.en: From Li Bai's 《送友人》 (opening 青山横北郭，白水绕东城). Quoted in farewell notes and essays.
usage.zh: 出自李白《送友人》（首联“青山横北郭，白水绕东城”）。常用于赠别、抒发离情。
